# node24-jmx25

> Node.js JMX client that bridges to a Java sidecar; targets Node.js 24+ and JDK 25.

Node.js library for reading and managing Java applications through JMX (Java Management Extensions). It spawns a packaged Java sidecar process and exchanges newline-delimited JSON over the child process's stdio. The public API is Promise-based; a legacy callback form is kept for backward compatibility. Features include per-request timeout, drain-aware write queue, stderr fail-fast guard, JMX notification subscriptions, and typed-key Map decoding. Credentials never leave the local pipe and are redacted from debug logs.

## Requirements
- Node.js 24 or later
- Java 25 or later at runtime
- Maven and JDK 25 to build the Java sidecar from a source checkout

## Core
- [README](https://github.com/Insider515/node24-jmx25/blob/main/README.md): usage, API reference, value decoding, notifications, reference benchmark
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/Insider515/node24-jmx25/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## API surface
- `createClient(options)` returns an EventEmitter-based `Client`
- Promise + optional callback: `getAttribute`, `getAttributes`, `getDefaultDomain`, `getDomains`, `getMBeanCount`, `listMBeans`, `invoke`, `setAttribute`
- Notifications: `addNotificationListener(mbean)`, `removeNotificationListener(subscriptionId)`
- Events: `connect`, `disconnect`, `error`, `notification`
- Options: `host`, `port`, `service`, `protocol`, `urlPath`, `username`, `password`, `classpath`, `requestTimeoutMs`, `stderrFailFastBytes`, `debug`

## Source
- [lib/client.js](https://github.com/Insider515/node24-jmx25/blob/main/lib/client.js): Node.js client, protocol framing, pending-request lifecycle
- [lib/javaValues.js](https://github.com/Insider515/node24-jmx25/blob/main/lib/javaValues.js): wire-type decoders and Java-compatible value wrappers
- [java-bridge/src/main/java/com/insider515/jmx/JmxBridge.java](https://github.com/Insider515/node24-jmx25/blob/main/java-bridge/src/main/java/com/insider515/jmx/JmxBridge.java): Java sidecar entry point and JSON-RPC dispatcher
